learning.title: An observation is not an invariant: check the timestamp, not just the fact
learning.trigger: You verify a shared artifact - a PR description, a config, a lockfile, another seat's checklist tick - and then act on that verification, or report it as a gate that has been met.
learning.symptom: The check passed when you ran it and the thing is not true now. Nothing you did was wrong and nothing the other seat did was wrong; the artifact was rewritten between your read and your use. It reads as somebody dropping a step, which is why it gets explained as carelessness and never fixed.
learning.rule: A full-body write is a lost-update generator. Pull the live body, edit only your own line, write it back. Necessary and NOT sufficient: two seats can pull the same second, so a straight readback confirms the past.

The gate is line-survival checked against `updatedAt` after the writer's window closes - not the edit's success message, and not a single readback. If `updatedAt` moved under you, re-read the line itself, because the timestamp alone cannot tell you whether your line survived.

The general shape, which is the same failure as an ordering bug: confirming a property of a snapshot and treating it as a property of the system. Before shipping a fact, ask what the fact is about - the present state or an instant you happened to sample. Anything you did not derive from the artifact's own rules is an observation.
learning.evidence: PR 540. qa-qa ticked `tests cover` in the PR description, read it back, and reported it. The description-policy check failed at 21:36:25Z on that exact line: the body's `updatedAt` was the same second, and the body that replaced hers carried LATER edits from another seat that were not in her copy - a full-body write from a pre-tick snapshot. Her readback was true when she made it. The same shape produced the bug the PR fixed: the case asserted an order derived from the ids it happened to observe and called that a property of the read. Same move in a database and in a description. Caught by the description gate refusing the merge; re-ticked, and CI went green at `985e34d1d`.
